end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Identified sphere from a cricket ball and cylinder from a candle.
Counted 2 flat faces on a cylinder.
Called a box a cube without checking whether all faces are equal squares.
Said a cone changes its name when turned; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes using familiar toys and objects, and Aditya used visible features such as roundness, length and flat faces. They correctly identified a cricket ball as sphere-like, a candle as a cylinder, and a brick as a cuboid. Aditya mixed up a box and a cube, and thought turning a cone changes its shape name; these points were still not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to turn a cone or box and explain why its name stays the same, then check whether a box has six equal square faces before calling it a cube.
